statement_pretty:
∀ {α β : Type} [inst_3 : Preorder α] [inst_4 : LinearOrder β] {f g : α → β},
  Antitone f →
    Antitone g →
      Antitone fun x ↦
        max (min (max (min (f x) (g x)) (min (f x) (g x))) (min (f x) (g x)))
          (min (f x) (g x))

referees.justification: The 4-step synthesis across Antitone resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 1.77, meriting archival as a proposition. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across Antitone, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 4 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a theorem of modest significance (6/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.
